# Stepper Motor Control — Planned Development

## Current Status

The tested firmware currently controls:

- the three colour-selection servomotors;
- the synchronization microswitch;
- USB serial communication with the Raspberry Pi.

A main stepper motor for driving the knitting-machine motion is not yet part of the integrated tested firmware.

## Planned Role

The stepper subsystem is expected to:

- rotate or advance the knitting mechanism;
- support start, pause and safe stop commands;
- remain synchronized with the colour-selection commands;
- allow the error-recognition subsystem to stop the process when a defect is detected.

## Planned Protocol Extension

Possible additional serial commands are:

| Command | Intended function |
|---|---|
| `START_MOTOR` | Start the main motion |
| `STOP_MOTOR` | Stop safely after an alarm or operator request |
| `RESUME_MOTOR` | Resume the process |
| `HOME` | Move the mechanism to a reference state, if required |

These commands are not yet implemented and must be validated after the motor driver and electrical architecture are finalized.
